key_insight: EviDTB predicts DFT Hamiltonians and estimates their uncertainty in a single forward pass, enabling uncertainty-guided materials screening.
engineering_relevance: Uncertainty scores can help prioritize materials for first-principles verification while reducing reliance on potentially unreliable predictions.
method: Applies evidential deep regression to tight-binding DFT Hamiltonian prediction.
Estimates prediction uncertainty without repeated inference passes.
Reports a better cost–uncertainty-performance balance than deep ensembles, Monte Carlo dropout, and mean-variance estimation.
evidence_signal: On 5,478 held-out structures, EviDTB achieved 0.622 meV full-SOC Hamiltonian matrix-element MAE and uncertainty–error Spearman ρ = 0.812; excluding the 15% most uncertain structures reduced the 99th-percentile mean local squared error by 78%.
watch_item: Reliability on chemical and structural spaces beyond the reported held-out evaluation requires further validation.
paper_title: Evidential Deep Regression for Universal Density Functional Theory Hamiltonian Models
